desc:
A classic cookie baking mix containing one 17.5‑ounce pouch. It’s part of America’s #1-rated cookie mix lineup, ideal for baking oatmeal cookies quickly at home target.com+5bettycrocker.com+5walmart.com+5.

Made for convenience: Just mix, drop, and bake” for soft‑and‑chewy homemade-style cookies in mere minutes
features:
• CLASSIC COOKIE MIX: Create oatmeal cookies for the whole family to enjoy (Do not eat raw cookie dough)

  • QUICK AND EASY: Just mix, drop, and bake for a chewy, delicious treat any time of the day or night

  • ENDLESS OPTIONS: Prepare cookie mix as is or explore Betty Crocker recipes for a new take on this classic oatmeal cookie

  • OATMEAL GOODNESS: Bite into sweet, soft, and chewy oven-baked oatmeal cookies

  • CONTAINS: One 17.5 oz pouch of Betty Crocker Oatmeal Cookie Mix
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Rolled Oats, Brown Sugar, Sugar, Palm Oil, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate), Salt, Nonfat Milk.
